svg.title: The response deadline lies beyond the drawn-as-of date
svg.desc: Put the response deadline beyond the drawn-as-of boundary with a still-open state. Do not depict compliance, noncompliance or a future response as already known. Visual distinction: An unbroken date rule with asymmetric ticks. Separates dated states without drawing an access restriction or a continuing identity.
